✅ Firmware Compatibility: GRBL 0.9 (open-source G-code interpreter for Arduino Uno/Mega)

Description:
The Arduino CNC Shield (SKU: DRV1001) is a compact, easy-to-use expansion board that turns an Arduino into a ready-to-run CNC controller. Designed for hobbyists and rapid prototyping, it runs open-source GRBL firmware and, when paired with an Arduino Uno or Mega and four removable stepper-driver modules, provides precise control of up to four stepper axes for routers, laser cutters, pick-and-place rigs, and other motion projects.

Applications Ideal for DIY CNC routers, laser cutters, 3-axis (or 4-axis) milling and engraving machines, small pick-and-place platforms, and any project needing reliable low-voltage stepper control driven by an Arduino.

Quick note Drivers and Arduino board are sold separately. When choosing a power supply and stepper driver, match the voltage/current specifications of your motors and driver modules (DRV8825 can tolerate higher voltages up to 36 V; A4988 is typically used at lower voltages).
